title: Ida caillorum matris / Portio nature precellentis (anonymous, Ivrea Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Ida caillorum matris / Portio nature precellentis. 4 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Contratenor, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
